clauses.quote: DCPS shall, in consultation with the WTU, develop and implement the following initiatives:

The parties agree to form a joint committee consisting of the Chancellor or a designee, the President of the WTU or a designee, and 3 representatives selected by the WTU President and 3 representatives selected by the Chancellor, to develop and implement a comprehensive mentoring and induction program.
